indications_and_usage: For the relief of the symptoms of dandruff.
warnings: For external use only. Do not use on wounds or damaged skin or on a child under 12 years of age unless directed by a physician.
when_using: Avoid contact with the eyes. If contact occurs, rinse eyes thoroughly with water.
stop_use: Conditions worsens or does not improve after regular use of this product as directed.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: If swallowed, get medical help or contact Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Apply a small amount quantity of the product into hair and massage the scalp. Rinse thoroughly with enough water, repeat if needed. For best results, use at least twice a week or as directed by a doctor.
other_safety_information: See on the bottom of the bottle for lot number and expiration date.
inactive_ingredient: Water (Aqua), Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Acrylates Copolymer, Cocamide MEA, Cocamidopropylamine Oxide, Caprylyl Glycol, Hexylene Glycol, Fragrance (Parfum), Polyquaternium-7, Sodium Hydroxide, Disodium EDTA, Citric Acid, Panthenol, Phenoxyethanol, FD&C Blue No.1 (CI 42090), Hexyl Cinnamal, Benzyl Salicylate, Coumarin, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Geraniol, Linalool.
